standard.summary: AdamW 的 L2 正则化强度。每步对参数施加 weight_decay × param 的衰减，防止参数无限增长和过拟合。
standard.effect: 默认 0.01（AdamW 论文推荐值）。增大到 0.1 可以更强地正则化，减小到 0.001 减少约束。
standard.whenToUse: 大多数训练保持默认 0.01。数据极少且过拟合明显时可适当增大。
standard.avoidWhen: 设太大（>0.5）会严重限制学习能力。设 0 关闭正则化——LoRA 训练中不推荐。

standard_en.summary: AdamW's L2 regularisation strength. Each step applies a decay of weight_decay * param to the parameters, which stops them growing without bound and guards against overfitting.
standard_en.effect: Defaults to 0.01 (the value recommended in the AdamW paper). Raising it to 0.1 regularises more strongly; lowering it to 0.001 loosens the constraint.
standard_en.whenToUse: Most training keeps the default 0.01. Raising it somewhat can help when data is very scarce and overfitting is obvious.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Set too high (>0.5) it seriously limits the capacity to learn. Setting 0 turns regularisation off -- inadvisable for LoRA training.

advanced.principle: AdamW 的 weight decay 与 L2 正则化不同：L2 在 loss 上加 λ/2·||θ||²（梯度中多出 λ·θ），而 AdamW 直接在参数更新中减去 λ·θ·lr。AdamW 的方式不会干扰动量估计，效果更稳定。
advanced.expectedImpact: 合适的 weight decay 可减少过拟合 5-10%。过大则欠拟合。
advanced.tradeoffs: LoRA 的可训练参数少，weight decay 的影响比全参 finetune 更温和。

advanced_en.principle: AdamW's weight decay differs from L2 regularization: L2 adds λ/2·||θ||² to the loss (so the gradient gains λ·θ), while AdamW subtracts λ·θ·lr directly in the parameter update. AdamW's way does not disturb the momentum estimates and is more stable.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: Appropriate weight decay reduces overfitting by 5-10%; too much causes underfitting.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: LoRA's trainable parameter count is small, so weight decay's effect is milder than in full-parameter finetune.
